contentText: Ukraine struck the Kerch Bridge linking Russia to occupied Crimea, but not all the dramatic footage circulating online is real. Multiple AI-generated videos falsely show the bridge collapsed with extensive damage. Some even used branding resembling a Ukrainian news agency to appear credible. While the bridge was indeed struck and damaged, the viral videos were fabricated using AI, as Vedika Bahl explains.
